lines.en: I walk slowly, mallet on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一带的石头，我都要看看。
lines.en: I want to inspect all the stone here.

lines.zh: 我在量墙的厚度，一格一格。
lines.en: I measure the wall's thickness, block by block.

lines.zh: 有人要修屋顶，我得过去。
lines.en: Someone needs a roof mended. I'm on my way.
My boots are covered in stone dust.
I walk steady so I don't drop my tools.

lines.zh: 这片村子，房子都是我修的。
lines.en: I built most of this village.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看屋檐，有点歪。
lines.en: I glance up at the eaves. Slightly crooked.

lines.zh: 我手里的锤子，用了很多年。
lines.en: I've had this mallet for years.

lines.zh: 我先去看看那块裂开的石头。
lines.en: First let me see that cracked stone.

lines.zh: 路上有只蝴蝶，我绕开走。
lines.en: A butterfly on the path. I step around.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边想怎么下料。
lines.en: As I walk, I plan the cuts.
I crouch and run a hand over the stone.
Good stock. This will do.

lines.zh: 我把工具摆开，一件一件。
lines.en: I lay out my tools, one by one.

lines.zh: 我数了数手上的茧，笑了。
lines.en: I count the calluses on my hands and smile.
A loose stone. I'll remember it.
I'm waiting for the chisel to finish sharpening.

lines.zh: 屋檐下有个蝶蛹，我不碰。
lines.en: A chrysalis under the eaves. I leave it be.
Someone's come to ask a price. I greet them first.
I brush the stone dust off my shoulders.
I've repaired this wall three times.
This work can't be hurried.

lines.zh: 我在听锤子的回声，判断厚度。
lines.en: I listen to the mallet's echo to judge the thickness.
Sun's high. I'll rest a moment.

lines.zh: 我把石头翻了个面，再看一遍。
lines.en: I turn the stone over and look again.
What needs fixing? Say it.
Your clothes aren't dusty with stone.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，手还在锤上。
lines.en: I look up at you, hand still on the mallet.

lines.zh: 我这儿的石头，都是好料。
lines.en: All my stone is good stock.
Buying, or hiring?
Let me wipe my hands first.
I know every wall in this village.

lines.zh: 你站在门口，我先让一让。
lines.en: You're in the doorway. Let me shift.

lines.zh: 我没什么好东西，只有石头。
lines.en: I've nothing fine to offer. Only stone.

lines.zh: 你看着不像来找我修东西的。
lines.en: You don't look like you came for repairs.

lines.zh: 有事就说，我手上还有活。
lines.en: Say what you need. I've work in hand.
I set the mallet down and listen properly.
Not too close. The chisel's sharp.
Everyone round here knows me.
Need directions? I know it all.
My hands are dirty. I won't shake.

lines.zh: 你等一会儿，我先把这块敲定。
lines.en: Give me a moment; let me finish this block.
Right. I'm listening.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，锤子撑住了。
lines.en: I step back and lean on the mallet.

lines.zh: 这一下打在肩上，抬不起来。
lines.en: That hit my shoulder. I can't raise it.

lines.zh: 我手上的活儿要耽搁了。
lines.en: My work will be held up now.
I'm panting. Blood mixed with stone dust.
Not the head. I still need to read plans.
I lean on the wall and straighten slowly.

lines.zh: 我砌石头，也卖蝴蝶的东西。
lines.en: I lay stone, and I sell butterfly goods.

lines.zh: 我把工具先收起来，别丢了。
lines.en: I put the tools away first. Can't lose them.
That will leave your hands sore too.

lines.zh: 我在村里干了这么多年……
lines.en: All these years in this village, and...
I know this stock.
Let me hold it. Let me weigh it.
Nice piece. Good for a window frame.
I hold it to the light.
Not for trade. I'll keep it.
Your price. Let me reckon.
I set it on the workbench.
This is stone, not food.
I run my hand over it. No pores.
Fine. I'll take it.
Sorry. I'm carrying stone.
That nearly shook the mallet loose.
Turning sideways so you pass.

lines.zh: 我身上全是硬的，撞着疼。
lines.en: Everything on me is hard. That would hurt.

lines.zh: 门口的砖，被我碰掉一角。
lines.en: I knocked a corner off the door's brickwork.
I crouch and pick the brick up.

lines.zh: 你没事吧？我这身板太重。
lines.en: All right? I'm heavy.
Don't push. My hands are full.

lines.zh: 这一下，把你的靴子弄脏了。
lines.en: That left dust on your boots.
I've moved half a block. Enough to pass.

lines.zh: 我把工具收拾好，才说话。
lines.en: I put my tools away before speaking.

lines.zh: 两个人修一面墙，快得多。
lines.en: Two people on one wall goes much faster.
You hand the stone; I set it.
Hard to find a good pair of hands in this trade.
We build the wall to shoulder height.
She reads angles better than I do.
Before dark, this wall will be done.

lines.zh: 我把最后一块石头按进去。
lines.en: I press the last stone into place.
When this is finished, dinner's on me.

lines.zh: 有她搭手，我不怕接大活。
lines.en: With her helping, I'll take the big jobs.
I bend and pick up a block.
This one's cracked. Unusable.
I've measured this stone.
I add it to the pile.
Even this offcut will do.
I wipe off the dust and check the grain.
This one on the ground was discarded.
I pocket it. No waste.

lines.zh: 这个不能砌墙，做地基吧。
lines.en: Can't build a wall with this. A foundation, then.

lines.zh: 我拿着它走了两步，又放下。
lines.en: I carry it two steps and set it down.
Don't touch that wall. Freshly built.
I set my tools down and stand straight.

lines.zh: 这一片是我修的，我护着。
lines.en: I built this. I'll defend it.
I've a mallet in hand. Don't push me.

lines.zh: 你踩的是我刚砌的墙角。
lines.en: You are standing on the wall corner I just laid.
I know the people of this village.
I lift the mallet a little.
You've cracked the slab I just laid.
I stand in the doorway and bar you.

lines.zh: 我这一身力气，不是白练的。
lines.en: This strength wasn't earned for nothing.
You swing, and I swing back.

lines.zh: 这活儿还没完，别来添乱。
lines.en: The job isn't done. Don't add trouble.

lines.zh: 我把凿子放进腰包，腾出手。
lines.en: I slip the chisel into my pouch and free my hands.
People live behind this wall.

lines.zh: 你退开三步，我就放下锤子。
lines.en: Three steps back and I'll lower the mallet.

lines.zh: 我把锤子换到右手，站定。
lines.en: I switch the mallet to my right hand and set my stance.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，别踩石板。
lines.en: I watch your feet. Don't step on the slabs.
I back step by step, guarding the door.
The mallet's at shoulder height. Perfect.
I'll let you strike first. Fair's fair.
I won't give up this ground.

lines.zh: 我脚下很稳，站了很多年。
lines.en: My feet are planted. Years of standing.

lines.zh: 我把凿子换到左手，腾出右手。
lines.en: I switch the chisel to my left hand and free the right.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，把工具挡在前面。
lines.en: I turn sideways and put the tool in front.
I'm measuring the reach. It's enough.

lines.zh: 这地方我熟，你不会比我熟。
lines.en: I know this place. Not as well as I do.
I wipe the sweat off my brow.
One step closer and I swing.

lines.zh: 石匠的活，是给蝶学家配货。
lines.en: A mason's work is stocking lepidopterists.

lines.zh: 前脚压着重心，石头很凉。
lines.en: Weight on my front feet; the stone is cold.
You move, I move.
I've held this spot a long time.

lines.zh: 我看了看锤子，又看看你。
lines.en: I glance at the mallet. Then at you.
Only a few blocks. Quick.

lines.zh: 锤子砸下去，石头都裂了。
lines.en: The mallet comes down and the stone splits.

lines.zh: 这一下打在你肩上，很沉。
lines.en: That lands on your shoulder. Heavy.
I swing it in a wide arc.
I missed and nearly fell.

lines.zh: 我不是打手，只会敲石头。
lines.en: I'm no fighter. I only know how to hit stone.

lines.zh: 这一下，我用了全身的力气。
lines.en: That took all my strength.
You back off, and I stop.

lines.zh: 石头碎屑溅得到处都是。
lines.en: Stone chips fly everywhere.

lines.zh: 锤面斜过去，擦着你的肩。
lines.en: The hammer face skids past and clips your shoulder.

lines.zh: 锤子砸在你护腿上，石屑飞。
lines.en: My hammer lands on your greave; stone chips fly.

lines.zh: 我把锤子扛回肩上，喘气。
lines.en: I shoulder the mallet and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 你打坏了我的活，我记住了。
lines.en: You spoiled my work. I'll remember.
Not accurate, but heavy.

lines.zh: 我退回去，站到脚手架后。
lines.en: I retreat behind the scaffolding.
The handle slipped. I gripped it tighter.
That one hit the corner of the wall.

lines.zh: 我推开工坊的门，石粉落下来。
lines.en: I push the workshop door and dust falls.
I built this wall.

lines.zh: 我把工具挂好，先看场地。
lines.en: I hang up my tools and survey the site.

lines.zh: 地上全是碎石，得清一清。
lines.en: Rubble all over the ground. Needs clearing.
Someone in the village wants work started.
First I measure the doorframe.

lines.zh: 屋檐下的蝶蛹还在，很好。
lines.en: The chrysalis under the eaves is still there. Good.
I roll up my sleeves.
Good stone in these parts.
Someone there? Let me look up.

lines.zh: 活儿多得很，一件一件来。
lines.en: Lots to do. One thing at a time.

lines.zh: 我把锤子从腰上解下来。
lines.en: I unhook the mallet from my belt.
This block hasn't been sawn yet.
I plant my feet before starting.
The site gets cleared before work begins.

lines.zh: 我把料堆整了整，靠着墙。
lines.en: I tidy the pile against the wall.

lines.zh: 村里的石板路，我熟得闭眼能走。
lines.en: I know the village's paving well enough to walk blind.

lines.zh: 我把门口的碎石扫到一边。
lines.en: I sweep the rubble aside from the doorway.

lines.zh: 火星落在我袖子上，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Sparks on my sleeve. I slap them out.

lines.zh: 我从脚手架上摔下来，腰都直不起。
lines.en: I fall off the scaffolding and can't straighten up.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我抓着石头往上撑。
lines.en: Water in my nose. I push off the stone.

lines.zh: 炸响把整面墙推倒在我身上。
lines.en: The blast topples the wall onto me.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进腿，我拔不出来。
lines.en: Something's in my leg. I can't pull it free.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光缠着我，工具都拿不稳。
lines.en: Strange light wraps me and my tools won't stay gripped.

lines.zh: 干了一整天，什么都没吃。
lines.en: A whole day's work and nothing eaten.

lines.zh: 雷打在脚手架上，我整个人一抖。
lines.en: Lightning hits the scaffolding and I jerk.
The scaffold comes apart; the stones fall first.
